predecessors.name: Czechoslovakia
predecessors.text: the Czech Republic, one of the two 'constituent states' of Czechoslovakia; the territory 'was divided along the existing internal borders'

ledger.x: 1993-01-01: the Czech Republic becomes an independent state.

certainty.note: The border with Slovakia follows the former internal boundary, settled 'via mutual negotiations, financial compensation' and then 'an international treaty covering the border modifications' (Dissolution of Czechoslovakia page) (1996…
